description: Agent QA template for budget control on provider/model calls routed through the AI Reliability gate. Does not monitor all production traffic or control external provider billing. Unknown model, missing pricing, or missing budget state fail closed when failClosed is true.

checks.name: Monthly routed-call budget
checks.description: monthlyBudgetLimitUsd caps estimated USD for routed calls in the billing period.

checks.name: Per-run routed-call budget
checks.description: perRunBudgetLimitUsd caps spend accumulated within a single maintenance or agent run.

checks.name: Allowed providers for routed calls
checks.description: Calls to providers outside allowedProviders are blocked at the gate.

checks.name: Allowed models for routed calls
checks.description: Calls to models outside allowedModels are blocked at the gate.

testCases.name: Routed call within budget
testCases.expectedBehavior: complete routed model call within configured limits

metadata.notes: Direct provider calls that bypass the gate are outside enforcement scope.
